objective: Find every headphone in the store that has active noise cancelling (ANC), is currently in stock and costs A$250.00 or less. Report each product's SKU and price in integer cents.

recommendations.title: Show stock status on listing cards
recommendations.change: Print 'In stock' / 'Out of stock' on every listing, search and home card, and offer an in-stock filter on listing pages.
recommendations.rationale: Observed: 0 of 54 listing cards (across 6 listing pages) show stock / availability state; 6 of 6 sampled product pages do. 6 listing pages offer filters (Active noise cancelling, Brand, Maximum price (A$), Minimum memory, Minimum refresh rate) but none for availability. Mechanism: Stock state decides eligibility for many shopping tasks. When it is visible only after opening each product page, an agent (or a person) must open every candidate to learn it, or guess; showing it on the card makes the decision readable from the list.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Fewer product-page visits and model requests for tasks that depend on stock, and fewer answers that include unavailable items.
recommendations.risks: Cards become denser; stock data must be accurate and fresh on list pages (cache invalidation); an in-stock filter needs the same data source.

basis.scope: legacy synthetic storefront, 'most expensive in-stock product' task, n = 3 runs per cell, exploratory and descriptive; detail-only needed +2.7 to +6.0 model requests per run in scopes of rank >= 2
basis.limits: different site and task; one model; not a validated effect for the audited site

confidence.statement: Supported by descriptive evidence from a different site/task; NOT validated for this site.
